title: Admin Access Discovery & Audit-forwarding Strategy for RBAC V2 and SSO Assurance
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Problem: After initial RBAC v2 rollout we still have gaps in reliable detection of admin-capable principals, inconsistent audit forwarding for cross-region control plane events, and some edge SAML assertion handling that can produce incomplete context in logs. This ticket is to design and deliver a small sprint that: (1) enumerates true admin-capable identities across services (console, API tokens, service accounts), (2) ensures audit events from the Private control plane and Dedicated admin paths are forwarded to the central audit pipeline with consistent schema and tenant tags, and (3) closes SAML assertion parsing gaps that lose critical attributes used for post-authz forensics.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical admin inventory produced: CSV export listing principal id, type, source (SSO/SAML/OIDC/local), last-used timestamp, and attached roles/permissions
Audit forwarding enabled for private-control-plane admin events with tenant and request-id tags present in target SIEM (sample query verified)
SAML assertion parsing fixes merged and deployed such that 'eduPersonEntitlement' and 'role' attributes are preserved for all SAML-initiated sessions
Automated test coverage for audit schema and SAML attribute extraction added to CI (>=80% for new modules)
Runbook updated: steps to triage admin-privilege abuse, and a one-click script to revoke or rotate offending service tokens
tasks: Discovery: run cross-service query to find principals with 'admin' or equivalent role grants and reconcile with SSO group mappings
Schema: define audit forwarding schema additions for admin events (tenant_id, request_id, principal_source, assay_version)
SAML: add parsing/normalization for attributes lost in proxy (edge case where NameID format = transient)
Forwarding: configure Fluent Bit pipeline for private-control-plane pods to send admin event stream to central logging topic with encryption-at-rest
Testing: end-to-end validation using dev tenant and SIEM validation dashboard
Docs+Runbook: update internal security runbook and Console admin UI notes
